subject: general
question: India's First Marine park is situated in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gulf of Kutch**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India's first marine national park is situated in the **Gulf of Kutch, in the state of Gujarat.**
 
• Marine National Park, Gulf of Kutch: It was **established in 1982** and covers an area of 162.89 square kilometers.
 
• The area surrounding the Marine National Park has mangrove forests that provide breeding grounds for fish and other marine life. These forests play a vital **role in stabilizing the coastal ecosystem**.
 
• The Gulf of Kutch Marine Park is known for its coral reefs, including both **fringing reefs and offshore platforms**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Gulf of Mannar** is Situated between the southeastern coast of India (Tamil Nadu) and the western coast of Sri Lanka.
 
• It is part of the **Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve**, which is the first marine biosphere reserve in India, **established in 1989.**
 
• **Rameswaram Island** is Located within the Gulf of Mannar, it is a popular pilgrimage site in India.
 
• **Jamnagar** is Situated in the state of Gujarat, on the western coast of India.
 
• Known for the** world's largest oil refinery, operated by Reliance Industries.**
 
• **Chennai** is the capital of the state of Tamil Nadu, located on the southeastern coast of India along the Bay of Bengal.
 
• Known as the **"Detroit of India"** due to its robust automobile industry.
